special_component_terms.conditions: No burn marks or short circuits caused by external power surges

allowed_fault_types.name: Power or Boot Failure
allowed_fault_types.description: Device fails to power on or boots erratically due to internal component defect

allowed_fault_types.name: Internal Display Defect
allowed_fault_types.description: Dead pixels, backlight bleeding, or internal controller fault (non-impact)

allowed_fault_types.name: Speaker or Audio Circuit Malfunction
allowed_fault_types.description: No sound, distorted audio, or blown internal DAC

allowed_fault_types.name: I/O Port Defect
allowed_fault_types.description: HDMI, USB, or charging port failure without physical pin breakage

allowed_fault_types.name: Factory Firmware Corruption
allowed_fault_types.description: System lock due to certified OEM firmware failure

exclusions.title: Physical Impact or Dropping
exclusions.description: Cracked casings, shattered screens, chassis deformation, or crushed components

exclusions.title: Liquid Ingress or Moisture Corrosion
exclusions.description: Internal rust, liquid contact indicator tripped, or oxidation

exclusions.title: Third-Party Repair or Tampering
exclusions.description: Broken warranty seals, uncertified third-party parts, or unofficial firmware modifications

exclusions.title: External Lightning or Grid Surge
exclusions.description: Damage resulting from improper voltage or lightning without surge protection

exclusions.title: Cosmetic Scratches and Dents
exclusions.description: Surface blemishes not affecting standard device operation
